implementation_status.verified_mechanism: channels/0.1.json records the product-verified 17-repository + 9-corpus combination for release pipeline gating, prebuilt wheelhouse assembly (mindie-wheels-bundle.tar.gz + release-channel.json), and audit provenance. Host plugins (each <= 1,200 production LOC) delegate runtime bootstrap, zero-Git prebuilt wheelhouse auto-updates (SHA256SUMS-verified --override install with 1h -> 6h non-reportable backoff), Active + Rollback .inuse-leased idle cutover, and zero-binding MCP routing to mindie-harness across all 7 native host plugins (Codex, Claude Code, Kimi, DSH, Google Antigravity, Tencent WorkBuddy, and OpenCode), while preserving independent GitHub Release floor discovery and user consent settings.
implementation_status.known_boundaries: The 0.1.16 channel pins verified releases across the 10 shared substrate/runtime/evaluation components (harness 0.1.4, knowledge 0.13.24, remote-dev 0.11.14, profiler 0.5.16, sim 0.9.18, coordinator 0.7.13, npu-top 0.3.5, diagnostics 0.5.17, debugger 0.1.4, mindie-bench 0.4.13), 7 native host plugins (Codex 0.1.38, Claude Code 0.1.30, Kimi 0.1.31, DSH 0.1.26, Google Antigravity 0.1.21, Tencent WorkBuddy 0.1.19, OpenCode 0.1.11), and 9 public domain corpora. All seven host plugins run silently by default while enabled—exposing strict 1:1 per-harness remote NPU tools plus frictionless SSH onboarding (remote_auth), deterministic engineering/debugging tools (mindie_doctor, diagnostics_status, diagnostics_bundle, debugger, coordinator, profiler, sim, npu_top), L1-L4 graded knowledge tools (knowledge_query, knowledge_explain, knowledge_feedback, knowledge_distill, knowledge_sync), and the mindie-harness single-state ExperimentLedger RSI loop (rsi_loop / experiment_ledger) over zero-pre-call-binding MCP (P2.7 / P2.8), with 3-tier gh-decoupled privacy (contribute / local-only / read-only), non-blocking task continuity SKILL.md rules, install guides isolated under docs/install/, and Stop capture strictly scoped to saved consent and authorized project_roots. See docs/release-compatibility-and-update.md for full update and reload boundaries.

patch_releases.summary: Initial 0.1.0 milestone baseline and Release Channel Manifest contract (channels/0.1.json). All 4 host plugins (v0.1.0) verify locked plugin-release auto-updates; direct runtime consumption of channels/0.1.json for in-place 0.1.x single-component hotfixes is the 0.1.x target architecture.

Shared SSH authentication in remote-dev 0.11.1 provides one-time password enrollment, public-key installation and recovery, cross-process/chat/plugin reuse, read-only monitor password fallback, and Git for Windows 2.56 SSH discovery. coordinator 0.7.0 and npu-top 0.3.0 reuse the same store. Codex 0.1.12, Claude Code 0.1.8, Kimi 0.1.7 and DSH 0.1.6 expose remote_auth and pin formal remote-dev 0.11.1; diagnostics aligns to existing formal 0.5.4. Nineteen real SSH tests across macOS, native PowerShell and actual WSL2 pass. Formal assets and source-bound benchmarks are verified; plugin initial baselines, isolated previous-formal updater acceptance and native catalog reload boundaries are recorded separately. The remaining component and seven corpus pins are preserved; historical value results are not relabeled.

profiler 0.5.1 (25c789cd42389c893234c5db20eca67e63b8878a) adds streaming native-library SHA256 digest checks, >=3s SQLite busy_timeout alignment, explicit TimeoutError propagation, and root CLI help/unknown-command diagnostics. Claude Code 0.1.9 (4f3450be4af65e0ee755d4d979695f3f6c5bca5e), Kimi 0.1.8 (c33006cc2a89ad0024396cdf838b1bfd6d6b7f35), and DSH 0.1.7 (223eedee381d06cbdbb096dc22e2d79dd5aa0cf2) complete native MCP registration across knowledge, remote, and components / mindie-tools (exposing diagnostics_status, diagnostics_bundle, coordinator, profiler, and sim with 660000ms outer tool timeouts) alongside Codex 0.1.12 and shared SSH authentication from remote-dev 0.11.1.

Knowledge 0.13.7 and four native plugin releases enable information-gap retrieval, shared explanation budgets, exact prerequisite revisions, and updates for managed Python module bindings. Installed-state acceptance exposed and fixed the legacy Kimi bootstrap-baseline regression and a DSH output-budget race. Codex adds verified native CLI 0.165.0-alpha.1.2 compatibility. mindie-bench 0.4.5 preserves missing knowledge observations and fixes native temporary-file placement. Historical simple-task cost signals and failed complex-task non-regression remain separately documented; automatic upgrades, one-time recovery of the damaged Kimi installation, and host reload evidence are recorded in docs/releases/0.1.4/automatic-update-acceptance.json.

0.1.5 ecosystem expansion and full G0-G5 benchmark verification: introduces mindie-agent-agy v0.1.0 (4f1fb18aeeb264fe1dbcf7342f38c53980438fa7) as the fifth official native host plugin (Google Antigravity), integrating all 7 shared runtime components (mindie-knowledge 0.13.7, remote-dev 0.11.2, mindie-coordinator 0.7.0, mindie-profiler 0.5.3, mindie-sim 0.8.1, npu-top 0.3.0, mindie-diagnostics 0.5.4) with native Antigravity tool aliases, per-conversationId /mindie-agent session leases, AGY_CONVERSATION_ID coordinator propagation, and brain transcript redaction. Synchronizes formal component pins (remote-dev 0.11.2, profiler 0.5.3, sim 0.8.1) and completes the zero-spoiler colloquial-prompt G0-G5 end-to-end benchmark across DSH (deepseek-flash, max) and Codex (gpt-6.1-sol, xhigh): L2 48-trial matrix lifts pass rate 4.0x from 12.5% (2/16, G0/G1) to 50.0% (8/16, G2) with 21.2%-47.1% latency reductions, G3 cross-task flywheel achieves 0.0->1.0 on DSH Partial RoPE and -58.5% to -63.4% tool calls / -19.8% wall time on Codex SFA MTP, G4 RSI exploration achieves 0.0->1.0 (-27.8%) on dsv4-sparse-mla and -30.9% speedup on triton-spatial-norm, and G5 5-episode evolution (82->83->84 units) verifies zero regression with -19.8% faster execution.
